findings.issue: The text-only Web Share fallback sends no QR, token, or guest-view link while telling the guest to show a QR; the no-Share fallback only downloads locally and can claim a clipboard copy even when Clipboard API is unavailable.
findings.consequence: On reachable supported browser branches, a resident completes Share but the guest receives no artifact that can be scanned or redeemed.
findings.correction: Make every fallback deliver a usable QR or short-lived guest-view link, report fallback outcomes honestly, and add browser tests for file-share, text-only-share, and no-Share/Clipboard branches through redemption.

findings.issue: A hinted pass writes flow.plate, but accepting a later no-hint pass does not clear it and Remove clears only flow.pass.
findings.consequence: A stale plate from pass A can be submitted as an ordinary check-in or redeemed against pass B, creating an incorrect vehicle/session record.
findings.correction: Atomically clear or replace all pass-derived plate/read state when selecting or removing a pass, track provenance if needed, and add state/UI regression tests for hinted-pass removal and replacement by a no-hint pass.

findings.criterion: 2 plus accessibility — verify and submit prepopulated data
findings.issue: Successful scanning unmounts the scanner without focus management or a live/status announcement; with AI enabled the prefilled field remains hidden behind the camera view, and no browser test verifies an editable prefilled field through submission.
findings.consequence: Keyboard/screen-reader users can lose context, and the required in-context prepopulate/verify/submit flow is not established.
findings.correction: Reveal or navigate to a labeled editable prefilled plate control, announce/focus the accepted result, and add a browser test that scans a signed hinted pass, verifies and edits the field, submits it, and asserts focus and the stored plate/pass association.

findings.criterion: 3 and 4 — camera plate scanning during check-in and checkout
findings.issue: Recorded verification covers pure ALPR helpers only. The existing fake-camera check-in E2E was not recorded as run, and no checkout camera E2E exists.
findings.consequence: Actual getUserMedia-to-field behavior for both required flows remains unverified in context.
findings.correction: Run and record the fake-camera check-in story and add/run a checkout fake-camera story that opens a session, scans its plate, asserts field prepopulation, and reaches the correct review without manual entry.

findings.issue: The cron route calls processStayAlerts, but no test invokes that function or the combined cron route; the existing test helper calls only processPassReminders and therefore proves guest reminders, not supervisor delivery at 10h/11h.
findings.consequence: The explicit supervisor-notification requirement has only source-level evidence and cannot pass the required execution-based review.
findings.correction: Add an integration test through the combined cron orchestration that observes supervisor messages at 10h and 11h, proves idempotency, and confirms the 12h pass notification is not duplicated while retaining existing guest reminder behavior.

findings.criterion: 6 and 7 plus UX — admin CRUD and super-admin cross-property operation
findings.issue: API integration tests cover data operations and menu unit tests cover visibility, but no rendered-browser CRUD or cross-property Super Admin run is present in the recorded evidence.
findings.consequence: The user-facing, responsive ability to complete the required operations remains unverified in context.
findings.correction: Run and record the existing CRUD/roles/menu Playwright stories at desktop and narrow mobile widths, extending them to edit/delete after switching a Super Admin into a second property and to prove a regular admin cannot cross that boundary.
